property.name: hideHiddenOptions
property.description-key: Hide options marked as hidden in the option set

value.name: Value
value.description-key: Sort by the value of the options

value.name: Text
value.description-key: Sort by the text of the options, corresponding to the user language

property.name: placeholderText
property.description-key: Placeholder text shown when no option is selected. A read-only empty field always shows ---.

property.name: componentHeight
property.description-key: Set the height of the dropdown component

property.name: selectionShape
property.description-key: Corner shape of the selected value chip

property.name: makeFontBold
property.description-key: Display the selected value in bold font weight

property.name: useExternalValueForIcon
property.description-key: When enabled, the External Value of the choice will be used as the icon name for that choice option. Accepts an MDL2 icon name or the name of a square image web resource, e.g. hek_MyLogo.png. Semicolon-separate several values (hek_Logo.png;Tag) to try them in order - the first one that renders wins, then the Icon property.

property.name: icon
property.description-key: The Fluent UI MDL2 icon to display (browse and copy names at https://www.flicon.io), or the name of a square image web resource in this environment, e.g. hek_MyLogo.png. Semicolon-separate several values to try them in order. When nothing resolves, a dot in the icon color is shown.

property.name: showColorIcon
property.description-key: Color each icon with its option color (#255BA4 for options without one). When off, MDL2 icons render in the text color and image web resources render in greyscale

property.name: showColorBackground
property.description-key: Background of the selected value chip: No uses Selection color, Lighter a faded option color, Full the option color. Options without a color use Selection color

value.name: Lighter
value.description-key: Lighter version of the option color

property.name: selectionColor
property.description-key: Background of the selected value chip when Show option color background is No, and for options without a color (hex, e.g. #EDF3FB)

property.name: showColorBorder
property.description-key: Show a border in the option color around the selected value chip (#255BA4 for options without a color)

property.name: iconColorOverride
property.description-key: Override the option colors (icon, chip background and border) with a custom hex color (e.g. #FF0000 or FF0000)

property.name: hoverColor
property.description-key: Background of an option in the drop-down list while hovered or keyboard-highlighted (hex, e.g. #F3F2F1)

property.name: listSelectedColor
property.description-key: Background of the selected option in the drop-down list (hex, e.g. #EDF3FB)
